evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Harnesses are still handcrafted, and HarnessX, which evolves them automatically, starts each benchmark from a handcrafted harness, reports gains on the tasks it evolved on, and budgets 100 to 175 million meta-agent tokens per benchmark.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Evolving on the graded tasks of five agentic benchmarks with a frozen Qwen3.5-9B, LiteEvo lifts pass@2 by 10.5 to 67.7pp and reaches comparable or higher pass@2 than a reproduction of HarnessX (71.0 against 67.3 on average) at 13.0 lower mean API cost.
